name: opusclip-hackathon
description: Audience research -> OpusClip -> clip review, joined by a local coordinator

scripts.setup: npm --prefix audience-research ci && npm --prefix clip-review ci && npm --prefix integration ci
scripts.test: npm --prefix audience-research test -- --no-cache && npm --prefix clip-review test && npm --prefix integration test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix audience-research run typecheck && npm --prefix clip-review run typecheck && npm --prefix integration run typecheck
